title: Dune It Up | KEY.co
meta_description: A Grand 30A Beach House Designed for Gathering
description_expanded: The house was more amazing than we could have had imagined. We had 23 people in our group and there was a bed for everyone! Because of all the kids we had with us the pool was perfect… it was so big and open and a favorite from our group for sure. We travel with these families all the time and have stayed in many different cities and houses and this house had everything you need for a large group. Plenty of space to hang out, multiple sinks, multiple dishwashers and plenty of fridge/freezer space. First time in a long time where we felt like the home was equipped to handle large groups. We would absolutely stay here again. Oh! And beach access was super easy. Literally right across the street and one house over. So getting our crew to the beach was a breeze. The second floor serves as the main living level of the home, showcasing sweeping Gulf views, a gourmet kitchen with a large quartz island, and multiple dining areas designed for gathering. The open living room leads to expansive balconies overlooking the Gulf and pool below. Two additional guest suites are located on this level. The third floor offers even more sleeping accommodations with four king suites, a media room with additional sleeper sofas, and a bunk nook perfect for larger groups. Guests can also enjoy two additional balconies and access to the rooftop deck, where panoramic Gulf views provide the perfect setting to relax after a day at the beach just steps away.
